description: Services converted to the dependency-injection pattern (SWLOR.Game.Server/Readmes/DependencyInjection.md). Each is a static facade Service.<name> that forwards to the instance class <name>Service behind the interface I<name>Service, both in Domain.<domain>. SWLOR.Architecture.Tests apply their rules to exactly these services: the pieces must exist, hold no static mutable state, keep the [NWNEventHandler] methods on the facade, and not be reached for by service location. The domain must match DomainMap.json. A service whose namespace Service.<name>Service also holds static classes with state or event handlers lists them in an optional "facades" array (names relative to SWLOR.Game.Server.Service, sorted): each stays a static facade (so handler names do not change) and forwards to its own instance class <Type>Service behind I<Type>Service in the same domain, and every rule applies to it too. Add a service here, sorted by name, in the pull request that converts it.
